sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Thirsty - Echo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Thank you for reaching out. I know you're investigating a certain person called Thirsty. Sanitar is investigating him as well, for a specific reason. He's always hunting for any information on TerraGroup's activities. Surely it's all connected. If you can intercept the data first, bring it to me, I'll pay you handsomely. Besides, in my hands, it won't cause another disaster."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate any information about Thirsty on Shoreline
- Obtain the information in Thirsty's hideout
- Hand over the found information

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 4× Aquamari water bottle with filter
- 2× M.U.L.E. stimulant injector
"Just a diary, nothing but that? Well, it could still prove valuable... That handwriting is terrible! It'll take a while to read it. Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Battered diary | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to obtain Thirsty's battered diary in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. It can be found in a room near the pool. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.
